notes.title: Bulk & Automation Update!
notes.content:
Big things are bubbling in your cauldron! This update brings powerful new tools to make running your shop smoother than ever. Hire magical gnomes, streamline your workflow with bulk orders and push your business to new heights with infinite progression!

These new tools allow players to play at their own pace- letting the bulk orders and gnomes do most of the work, if they want. 

In addition, there are new plants, potions and decorations, as well as an even bigger cauldron and overall tweaks have been made to game balancing.

Your potion empire is about to reach a whole new level!
Check out everything below, and happy brewing!

[h3]🎮NEW MECHANICS 🎮[/h3]
✅ Bulk orders! This allows the players to order potions and ingredients in bulk. Can be unlocked in the Alchemy shop
✅ Automation! The player can now buy helpers to automate various tasks in the shop. All automation helpers can be bought in the Alchemy Shop
🤝 Infinite progression levels! You can now keep levelling up your shop indefinitely past level 20

[h3]🕹️GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS🕹️[/h3]
✅ 3 new plants - Barrowlark, Eveningstar and Windwhistle. They can be found in the world (except for the elusive eveningstar) or bought both in powdered and potted plant form from the Plant shop
✅ 4 new potions. These potions are intended to bring more variety to mid to late game customer requests. The potions are: Basilisk's Gaze Elixir, Troll's Toxin Antidote, Warlock’s Focus Brew, Frosthide Fortification Brew
✅ Cashier- sell potions automatically to clients, can be upgraded twice to sell quicker and haggle more effectively
✅ Cleaner- automatically removes trash, can be upgraded twice to improve cleaning speed
✅ Watering helper - waters plants for you! Can be upgraded twice to speed up watering
✅ Stirring helper- automatically stirs the cauldron
✅ Mortaring helper- automatically mortars dried ingredients
✅ Shelf stocking helper- magically transports potions from the bottler to empty shelves
✅ 3 New decorations to take the appeal of your shop to the next level: Snake in a jar, Ship in a bottle, Orrery
🤝 New cauldron! A massive ancient cauldron is now available for players to purchase

[h3]🎨VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS🎨[/h3]
✅ Small improvements to haggle book visuals

[h3]⚖️BALANCING⚖️[/h3]
🤝 Rebalanced market event- the market will now have appropriate difficulty in later game
✅ Rebalanced the brew speed upgrades

[h3]⚙️STABILITY⚙️[/h3]
✅ The opened book now moves with the player if he is pushed by an NPC
✅ UI fixes for properly displaying large amounts of gold, reputation and appeal
🤝Added save delete confirmation


*🤝 Indicates changes suggested by the community

notes.title: Update #2 - Brewing speed, keybinds, more upgrades & fixes
notes.content:
Another week, another update! We’ve added some requested features, fixed various bugs and made quite a few quality of life improvements. Most notably we’ve added the ability to rebind keys and larger tools to improve your brewing efficiency. We’ve also added the ability to upgrade the stir stick, to speed up brew times. You can find a full list of the changes below.

We’ll continue to listen to the community as we continue to expand the game. Happy brewing!

[h3]🕹️GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS🕹️[/h3]
🤝Added key rebind options
🤝 Added larger carry box
🤝 Added larger watering can
🤝 Added ability to discard unneeded tools
🤝 Fertilizer can now be carried in the box

[h3]🎨VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS🎨[/h3]
🤝 Removed grass from tavern steps
🤝 Smoothed terrain next to the player’s shop
✅ Added sound to teleport box

[h3]⚖️BALANCING⚖️[/h3]

✅ Decreased price for large potions

[h3]⚙️STABILITY⚙️[/h3]
✅ Improved network stability to reduce disconnection during gameplay
🤝 Added additional effects to players drinking the Halcyon potion
🤝 Connection stability improvements
✅ Added new voice for female character
✅ Increased hit boxes for ingredients allowing for easier pickup
🤝 Improvements for market tutorial quest
🤝 Improvements for potion inspector
🤝 Removed faulty “bottler blocked” warnings
🤝 Fixes for appeal score initialization 
🤝 Fixes for ending cutscene
🤝 QoL improvements for controller
🤝 Increased controller look sensitivity
🤝 Made Halcyon brewing recipe consistent in books and quest log
🤝 Fixed quest info box not closing in certain cases
🤝 Ensured characters disappear when the expedition is started
✅ Fixed issues with teleporting carry box in certain cases
🤝 Fixed geometry in greenhouse- players can no longer get stuck behind stairs
🤝 Localization fixes

notes.title: Potion Shop Simulator is now Available! 🎉
notes.content:
The wait is over, you can now get to brewing the strongest of potions! We can’t wait to see what you brew and meet you in-game! We’re a 2 person team and we really put our heart and soul into this game. 

Your feedback means the world to us—please share your thoughts and help us grow. Join [url=https://discord.gg/5FDHSkdU9K]the Discord here[/url] and help the game improve update after update!

We will improving the game and fixing any bugs you find in the coming days and weeks, so keep an eye out for patches.

Thank you for being part of this journey and happy brewing! 🧙‍♂️✨

notes.title: Release date announcement
notes.content:
Finally we are nearing the end, thanks to a lot of effort and an awesome community! The game is coming very soon- March 5th, for more info check out our new trailer
[previewyoutube=alywoYg2FEk;full][/previewyoutube]
Here some of the features you can expect in the full release:
[list]
[*] [b]A colorful medieval fantasy setting[/b] creates the perfect ambiance for potion-making, and an interactive world provides an immersive simulator experience.
[*] [b]Co-op mode for up to four players[/b] lets your friends join in on the fun! Tour the village, take care of plants, and experiment with different brews alongside your fellow alchemists.
[*] [b]The world is alive with dynamic events[/b], featuring a day and night cycle that brings market days in town, a traveling merchant, market trends, royal commissions from the king, and more. Keep an eye on your calendar so you don’t miss a thing.
[*] [b]Improve your reputation[/b] by making and selling potions, and generate income to upgrade your shop's aesthetics and efficiency. You can purchase additional items at the markets, from the traveling salesman, or at small shops downtown.
[*] [b]The discovery of new potions awaits[/b], so experiment to progress through the game. The more you brew, the more you sell! So, get adventurous with your potion combinations.
[*] [b]30+ main and side quests[/b] complete with missions designed to uncover the secret tales of the town and its mystical villagers 
[/list]

As we’re shifting the focus to the full game, we don’t have the capacity to support 2 versions of the game, therefore the [b]demo has been taken offline[/b]. Huge thanks to everyone who played it and gave us valuable feedback. That really helped make the full game better!

We’re so excited to finally share the full version of the game with you and can’t wait to brew some potions together!

Also make sure to join the Discord to follow progress and give your own input to possibly change the future of the game: [url=https://discord.gg/9AQHPZEexF]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Steam & Early Access
notes.content:
First off, we're finally on Steam! (Trailer coming soon)
This is an exciting milestone for us, and we're aiming for an Early Access release in April.

We also have a [url=https://discord.gg/ySSmZ7aFxk]Discord[/url], so go ahead and join that in order to interact with us and get more frequent updates on the game: [url=https://discord.gg/ySSmZ7aFxk]https://discord.gg/ySSmZ7aFxk[/url]
There will also be shared videos in the future, going over the development of the game, so make sure to check in so you don't miss those!

To clarify a bit about the Early access status of the game, we aren't intending on releasing a game with a large lack of mechanics or missing content. We are however aiming to further improve the game beyond initial release to include more focus on automation and further end-game replay-ability.

Upon release, all the features on the Steam page are there and many more! But it can also happen that you'll encounter bugs or oddities, and just know that by reporting them, they will get fixed!

We hope to chat with you in the Discord and see you brewing some weird potions and creating a thriving potion shop within the magical world of Potion Shop Simulator!

See you there!
